q: How do you turn filtered gron back into JSON?
task: You gronned an API response, grepped one subtree, and now need valid JSON again. Which gron flag reverses the operation, what does it turn the filtered assignments into, and what is the short spelling shown in the ungronning section?

q: What alias shortens the reverse operation?
task: You type the reverse flag all day and want a shorter name. Which two aliases does the manual recommend for the reverse operation, where do you put the alias line, and what exact command does each alias wrap?

q: When do you pass -v to gron?
task: Your pipeline needs only the right-hand sides of gron assignments without paths. Which gron flag prints just the values of provided assignments, what is its short spelling, and what does it drop from each line?

q: How do you gron JSON lines?
task: Your input is JSON lines where each line is its own object, not one big document. Which gron flag treats each line of input as a separate JSON object, what is its short spelling, and what breaks without it?

q: When do you pass -j to gron?
